# grok 1.0.77 (50ca579fa996)

`trust.txt`: the folder trust dialog a fresh start drew on 2026-11-11 when the launch line
carried no `--trust`, read from the pane with `herdr pane read` (the folder path is replaced by a
synthetic one). The dialog takes one key: `y` proceeds, `n` quits. With `--trust` on the line the
same fresh folder opened straight on the prompt.
